D: Four high school friends make a pact to change their lives before graduation.
P: Serve dessert when Jim's dad walks into the kitchen.
S: Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, served with a blue cheese dip and celery.
the gang's hangout at the Dog Years diner
Thick-cut fries cooked twice, at 140C then 190C until crisp, tossed with salt and served with gravy and melted cheese.
Michelle and all her band camp stories
Corn cobs boiled, then charred on a hot grill and brushed with smoky paprika butter and fresh lime.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, slow cooked at 150C for 3 hours wrapped in foil, then glazed with barbecue sauce over hot coals, with coleslaw.
Chicken parmigiana: crumbed breasts fried until golden, topped with napoli sauce, ham and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling, with chips and salad.
W: the pie Jim's mum left cooling
Granny Smith apples cooked with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, served warm with ice cream.
K: Espresso stirred into cocoa and hot milk, frothed and topped with whipped cream and grated chocolate.

s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter. Mix 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream to dip and serve with celery sticks.

s.note: Michelle and all her band camp stories
s.how: Cut 4 corn cobs into thirds and boil for 4 minutes. Drain, then char on a hot grill pan for 6 to 8 minutes, turning. Melt 60g butter with 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt, brush over the corn and squeeze over 1 lime to serve.

m.how: Halve 2 chicken breasts, crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g panko and fry until golden. Top with 250ml napoli sauce, 4 slices ham and 200g mozzarella and grill until bubbling. Fry 1kg potato chips twice and serve with a green salad.

w.note: the pie Jim's mum left cooling
w.how: Cook 1kg sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes and cool. Line a dish with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

d.how: Brew 4 espressos with 72g ground coffee. Whisk 2 tbsp cocoa into 600ml hot milk until frothy. Pour the coffee into four mugs, top with the chocolate milk, whipped cream and grated dark chocolate.
